questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

If she likes something, she'll buy it _______ much it costs.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'however'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• 
 
The sentence "If she likes something, she'll buy it however much it costs" conveys that the cost of the item does not affect her decision to purchase it.

 
 
• 
 
In this context, "however" is used to indicate that regardless of the cost, she will still buy the item.

 
 
• 
 
Therefore, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank is "however." emphasizing that the cost does not matter in her decision to purchase the item.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Could you spell your name _______, please?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'again'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence requires an **appropriate word **from the given options to fill the given blank.
 
• Let us explore the options :
 
• ** Weakly **means in a way that is not physically strong.
 
• ** Never **means not at any time or not on any occasion.
 
• ** Again **means once more; another time.
 
• ** Forever** means for all time; permanently.
 
• From the above meaning of the given options, 'again' fits the given blank as it explains the context of the sentence.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is** option 3.**

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

He persuaded other towns near Amman to send ______ soldiers to help him.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'their'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence*** 'He persuaded other towns near Amman to send ______ soldiers to help him.' ***requires a most **approrpriate word **from the given options to fill the given blank.
 
• Moreover, from the given context we are sure that the given blank requires a** possessive pronoun **that help us show possession or ownership in the sentence.
 
• From the given options , the marked option** 'their'** is the possessive form of the third person plural noun 'they'. It is used to **show possession or it means 'belonging to them'.__**
 
• Like in this sentence, the soldiers are owned by other towns which are near Amman . Hence, the most appropriate word is ** 'their'.**
 
• The correct answer is **option 3.**

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

When I _______ him last, he was busy in painting a mural on the wall of a temple.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**met**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is indicating that we are talking about the past tense as the time phrase '*last*' is being used and also the **2nd segment** of the sentence(**he was busy....**) indicates the presence of the past tense.
 
• 'Met' in Option 2 and '**was meeting**' in Option 1* *indicate the presence of past tense but as the **1st segment** of the sentence indicates that we **aren't **talking about **anything that was done in a continuous manner **but rather about **something which had happened in the past**.
 
• Simple past tense shows that we are talking about something that has already happened.
 
 
• For example:- *She **played **chess in the evening.*
 
 
 
• Therefore the **correct sentence **is - When I met __him last, he was busy in painting a mural on the wall of a temple. 

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

What _______ to their dog when they go for camping next week?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**will happen**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is indicating that we are talking about the future tense as the time phrase '*next week*' is being used.
 
• '**Will happen**' in Option 2* *indicates the presence of future tense.
 
• Future tense means a tense expressing an action that has not yet happened or a state that does not yet exist.
 
 
• For example:- *She'll write the e-mail after lunch.*
 
 
 
• Therefore the** correct sentence** is - What will happen__ to their dog when they go for camping next week?

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Many of the roads in the Pragati Maidan complex _______ again within next six months.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**will be laid**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is indicating that we are talking about the **future tense** as the **time phrase** '*next six months*' is being used.
 
• **'Will'** in **Option 1*** *indicates the presence of **future tense**.
 
• Future tense means a tense expressing an action that has not yet happened or a state that does not yet exist.
 
 
• For example:- **She'll **write the e-mail after lunch.
 
 
 
• Therefore the correct sentence is - Many of the roads in the Pragati Maidan complex **will be laid** __again within next six months.

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Prateek will not be able to fund his education in the US _______ he takes an educational loan.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'unless'**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• We use the conjunction unless to mean ***‘except if***__’. The clause which follows **unless** is a subordinate clause.

 
 
• Ex- *They won’t come unless you invite them.*
 
 
 
• In the given sentence the use of **'unless**' in the blank is appropriate as per the context.
 
• The complete sentence - Prateek will not be able to fund his education in the US **unless** he takes an educational loan. 

 Hence the correct answer is*** '*****Option 4'**

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Why _____ this editor always make such rude remarks? Our writers get offended.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**does**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• As the sentence is in simple present tense, each and every segment of the sentence should be in the same tense.
 
• In the given blank, we will use 'does' as in the **interrogative part** of the given sentence, we are talking about *only a single editor who makes rude remarks. *
 
• The general structure of Simple present tense in an interrogative form for WH-questions is - Wh-question + do/does + subject + verb + object?
 
• Therefore, the **correct sentence** is - Why does __this editor always make such rude remarks? Our writers get offended.

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.
